description: Header file defining the HpackEncoder class for HPACK header compression in HTTP/2, including methods for encoding header blocks, managing dynamic table size, and handling header representations.

classes.name: HpackEncoder
classes.description: Main class for encoding HTTP/2 headers using HPACK, managing header table, encoding header blocks, and supporting incremental encoding.

classes.name: HpackEncoder::ProgressiveEncoder
classes.description: Abstract class for incremental header encoding, allowing encoding in parts.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Encodes a set of headers into a header block string.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a ProgressiveEncoder for encoding headers incrementally.

methods.name: EncodeRepresentations
methods.description: Returns a ProgressiveEncoder for encoding header representations incrementally.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Updates the dynamic table size setting based on remote endpoint settings.

methods.name: CurrentHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Returns the current header table size setting.

methods.name: SetIndexingPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for indexing headers into the dynamic table.

methods.name: SetHeaderListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for header processing events.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the dynamic header table.
